<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><p data-block-key="dc55g">Today, we’re building on the progress of our widely used Flash series by introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash, our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.</p><p data-block-key="9p4rh">This release comes just three weeks after <a href="https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-3-6-flash-3-5-flash-lite-3-5-flash-cyber/">Gemini 3.6 Flash</a>, and is a direct result of developer feedback and algorithmic innovations that we look forward to bringing to future models. 3.7 Flash delivers substantial improvements across software engineering, knowledge work, and web development workflows — with an introductory price of half the original 3.6 Flash cost per million tokens.</p><h2 data-block-key="a21f8">Better intelligence for complex workflows</h2></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><p data-block-key="dc55g">3.7 Flash shows strong gains over 3.6 Flash in coding tasks like debugging and issue resolution. It also achieves higher first-pass code accuracy and has improved performance in generating production-ready code as seen in <a href="https://cognition.com/frontiercode">FrontierCode 1.1 Main</a> (43.6% vs 34.4%) and <a href="https://deepswe.datacurve.ai/">DeepSWE v1.1</a> (65.3% vs 49.0%).</p><p data-block-key="bc56l">In web development, 3.7 Flash generates more functional layouts and feature-complete apps in fewer prompts. For UI generation, the model shows high design adherence and parity based on a reference input, whether it’s a screenshot, an image, or a full design system. It outperforms 3.6 Flash on Arena.ai’s <a href="https://arena.ai/leaderboard/code/webdev">WebDev Arena</a> with an Elo score of 1588 vs 1538.</p><p data-block-key="8lh0m">For knowledge-dense fields like finance, law, and biosciences, 3.7 Flash delivers improved reasoning and accuracy. It significantly outperforms 3.6 Flash on the GDP.pdf benchmark (34.0% vs 22.0%), an eval for testing a model’s ability to process complex documents. It also surpasses 3.6 Flash in <a href="https://zapier.com/blog/introducing-automationbench/">AutomationBench</a>, demonstrating it can more effectively complete real-world business workflows (30.4% vs 17.0%).</p></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><h2 data-block-key="cunpc">Better developer experience and price</h2><p data-block-key="6cr13">Gemini 3.7 Flash delivers a noticeably improved developer experience over 3.6 Flash. It better adapts to roadblocks, clarifies intent when needed, and follows instructions with greater fidelity. It thinks more diligently, putting in more effort into multi-step planning and tool calls. A more disciplined execution means less manual oversight and fewer retries across engineering workflows.</p><p data-block-key="b3o9l">3.7 Flash is available through the end of the year at an introductory price


<a class="superscript"
  data-ga4-analytics-superscript-click
  data-tooltip-content-id="footnote-content-1" 
  data-target="inline text"
  href="#footnote-1"
  id="footnote-source-1"
  aria-label="Jump to link reference 1">
  <sup>1</sup>
</a>
of $0.75/1M input tokens and $3.75/1M output tokens. This price combined with the enhanced model performance enables developers and customers to scale production-ready agents cost effectively.</p></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><h2 data-block-key="vbt12">Improving Gemini Spark with 3.7 Flash</h2><p data-block-key="90mbq">Gemini Spark, available to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in over <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17094507?hl=en&amp;co=GENIE.Platform%3DAndroid&amp;sjid=2353166824601345951-NA#:~:text=Available%20wherever%20Gemini%20Apps%20are%20supported%2C%20except%20in%20the%20European%20Economic%20Area%2C%20Nigeria%2C%20Switzerland%2C%20and%20the%20United%20Kingdom">160 countries</a>, will be using Gemini 3.7 Flash starting today. We launched Spark at I/O as your personal AI agent that runs 24/7, taking action on your behalf while under your direction. This model update makes Spark more efficient for knowledge work with improved tool use for Google Workspace apps, delivering improved accuracy and output quality for complex, multi-skill workflows.</p></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>

  

  
    





























<section class="uni-page uni-grid uni-inline-image-section" data-component="uni-inline-image">
  <uni-inline-image
    class="uni-inline-image uni-inline-image--full"
    alignment="full"
    alt-text="MP4 showing how with Gemini 3.7 Flash, Gemini Spark helps turn your ideas into action"
    external-image=""
    or-mp4-video-title="spark manufacturing"
    or-mp4-video-url="https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-uniblog-publish-prod/original_videos/sparkManufacturing-edit-v3_260812d_NO_AUDIO.mp4"
    section-header="Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash"
    
    
    
    
    
      autoplay="true"
    
  >
    
      <div slot="caption-slot">
        <div class="rich-text"><p data-block-key="jbzaz">With 3.7 Flash, Gemini Spark can turn ideas into action more efficiently by consolidating files, drafting emails, and updating status documents.</p></div>
      </div>
    

    
  </uni-inline-image>
</section>

  

  
    

<section
  class="uni-page uni-grid uni-article-paragraph"
  data-analytics-module='{
    "module_name": "Paragraph",
    "section_header": "Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash"
  }'>
  <uni-article-paragraph class="uni-article-paragraph__container uni-grid__col--layout-6">
    <div class="rich-text"><h2 data-block-key="vbt12">Built with safety in mind</h2><p data-block-key="ae21r">We continually work to improve the coverage and robustness of <a href="https://deepmind.google/frontier-safety/">Frontier Safety safeguards</a>. Gemini 3.7 Flash is shipping with updated safeguards against misuse in the domains of Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) and cyber offense, while enabling beneficial use cases, in accordance with <a href="https://deepmind.google/blog/our-approach-to-bioresilience/">our approach to bioresilience</a> and our <a href="https://deepmind.google/blog/introducing-gemini-3-5-flash-cyber/">cyber program</a>.</p><p data-block-key="bnksf">For more information, see the 3.7 Flash <a href="https://deepmind.google/models/model-cards/gemini-3-7-flash">model card</a>.</p><h2 data-block-key="8nhsj">Try it today</h2><ul><li data-block-key="7n9tj"><b>Developers</b>: Explore agent-first workflows in <a href="https://antigravity.google/">Google Antigravity</a> or start building today in the Gemini API via <a href="https://ai.dev/prompts/new_chat?model=gemini-3.7-flash">Google AI Studio</a> and <a href="https://developer.android.com/studio">Android Studio</a>. Get started with our <a href="https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/latest-model">developer guide</a>.</li><li data-block-key="21gi9"><b>Enterprises</b>: Access 3.7 Flash in <a href="https://console.cloud.google.com/agent-platform/publishers/google/model-garden/gemini-3.7-flash">Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform</a> and the <a href="https://cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise?e=48754805">Gemini Enterprise</a> app.</li><li data-block-key="e7lo3"><b>Individuals</b>: Available via Spark, your 24/7 personal agent in the Gemini app for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/17094507?hl=en&amp;co=GENIE.Platform%3DAndroid&amp;sjid=2353166824601345951-NA#:~:text=Available%20wherever%20Gemini%20Apps%20are%20supported%2C%20except%20in%20the%20European%20Economic%20Area%2C%20Nigeria%2C%20Switzerland%2C%20and%20the%20United%20Kingdom">supported countries</a>.</li></ul><h2 data-block-key="a45hi">Detailed benchmarks</h2></div>
  </uni-article-paragraph>
</section>
